items.source: In a typical request/reply scenario, the incoming Message may convey the destination to use for the reply. In that case, that destination should take precedence.
items.translation: 在典型的请求/回复场景中，传入的Message 可能会传达用于回复的目标。在这种情况下，该目标应优先使用。

items.source:
This annotation may be placed class-level in which case it is inherited by
methods of the class.
items.translation: 此注解可置于类级别，在这种情况下，该类的方法将继承该注解。

items.source: The destination for a message created from the return value of a method.
items.translation: 方法返回值所创建的消息的目的地。
